note: The viewer schema is declared by hand because the step struct varies across shards: `reflection` is present on 112709 of the 147471 published steps and absent on the other 34762, and `tool_call.args` is a per-tool key bag (32 distinct keys) whose `body` value is sometimes a string, sometimes a list and sometimes an object. The datasets-server infers the struct from an early shard and then cannot cast a later one, so declaring the union restores the parquet index without rewriting a single historical raw record.

features.name: chosen
features.note: the preferred branch; carries its own `steps`, `outcome` and `reward`, not the record-level ones

struct.name: args
struct.note: always an object; keys differ per tool and `body` is a string, a list or an object depending on the tool

struct.name: reward
struct.note: key-bag scoring this branch alone: `success` on every record, plus `task_success` and `verify_before_mutate` on 5991, and `process_quality` and `verify_rigor` on 147

features.name: rejected
features.note: the dispreferred branch; same shape as `chosen`, with its own `steps`, `outcome` and `reward`

struct.name: args
struct.note: always an object; keys differ per tool and `body` is a string, a list or an object depending on the tool

struct.name: reward
struct.note: key-bag scoring this branch alone: `success` on every record, plus `task_success` and `verify_before_mutate` on 5991, and `process_quality` and `verify_rigor` on 147

features.name: reward
features.note: key-bag scoring the pair, distinct from the per-branch `chosen.reward` / `rejected.reward`: `success` on every record, plus `preference_margin` and `same_goal` on 6156

features.name: meta
features.note: key-bag: `factory`, `generator`, `round` on every record, plus `kind`, `plant`, `rejected_sin`, `divergence_step`, `construction` on 6156, `chosen_steps` / `rejected_steps` on 6108, `also_sin` on 6107, `tool` / `fork` on 1611, `leftover` on 1533, `magnet_challenge` on 24, `diatool_type` on 7 and `diatool_states` on 2

disclosures.summary: Six `tool_call.args` objects are empty. They are the argument-free discovery calls (`list_routes`, `list_tools`, `list_rooms`) on three `diatool` records, one on each record's chosen branch and one on its rejected branch. They are kept exactly as generated.

disclosures: All 6192 records are `tool-use-preference-factory` preference triples generated by `grok-4.6`, each with a unique `tup-` id. There is no leftover-mill mix and no dest-stamped foreign payload in this dataset.

Every step publishes a public `decision_basis`. A step carries exactly `n`, `decision_basis`, `tool_call`, `observation` and, on 112709 of 147471 steps, `reflection`: there are no hidden `thought` or `internal_reasoning` fields.
